name: Saikawa Kikuno
source:
Kikuno is [url=/c51882]Mitsuru's[/url] childhood friend and personal maid, and also a member of the Shadow Operatives. She is very passionate about her job, and is known for going out of her way to do things to make people as comfortable as possible.

[Edited from [url=http://megamitensei.wikia.com/wiki/Kikuno_Saikawa]Megami Tensei Wiki[/url]]
